pronunciation.RTL-SDR: R T L S D R

screens.title: Home
screens.narration: Home reports device readiness and opens the radio or global Settings.

screens.title: Navigation panel
screens.narration: NAV provides direct tuning, band shortcuts, zoom, filter, step, peak, and center controls.

screens.title: Connectivity settings
screens.narration: Connectivity manages Wi-Fi power, antenna choice, scanning, saved networks, and connection status.

screens.title: Location and ADS-B settings
screens.narration: Location and ADS-B stores the receiver position and radar range without requiring a phone.

screens.title: Data and maps settings
screens.narration: Data and Maps reports aircraft databases and offline map packs.

screens.title: Display and audio settings
screens.narration: Display and Audio controls brightness, timeout, volume, sound defaults, and rotation.

screens.title: Radio defaults
screens.narration: Radio Defaults controls startup reception, graphics, the last band, and FM frequency.

screens.title: Storage settings
screens.narration: Storage reports SD health and reserves destructive maintenance for confirmed actions.

screens.title: Companion settings
screens.narration: Companion features are optional and never required for normal on-device operation.

screens.title: System settings
screens.narration: System reports firmware, uptime, power, and diagnostics.

screens.title: FM Listen
screens.narration: FM Listen combines tuning, presets, relative level, stereo meters, RDS text, and seek controls.

screens.title: FM Spectrum
screens.narration: FM Spectrum shows the tuned carrier, filter bandwidth, spectrum, waterfall, and tap-to-tune controls.

screens.title: FM Station and RDS
screens.narration: Station and RDS explains program service, radio text, PI code, program type, stereo, and decoder lock.

screens.title: FM RF Health
screens.narration: RF Health exposes sample rate, USB, DSP, audio, Wi-Fi, driver, and last-error telemetry.

screens.title: FM Settings
screens.narration: FM Settings contains band-specific audio, filter, preset, and navigation controls.

screens.title: P25 Monitor
screens.narration: P twenty-five Monitor follows control and voice channels and exposes survey, hold, and skip actions.

screens.title: P25 Spectrum
screens.narration: P twenty-five Spectrum centers the active channel and shows signal energy across the selected span.

screens.title: P25 Talkgroups
screens.narration: Talkgroups lists recent grants and lets the operator hold a known public talkgroup.

screens.title: P25 Program
screens.narration: Program controls automatic following, encrypted-call skipping, survey, and exit to Home.

screens.title: P25 RF Health
screens.narration: P twenty-five RF Health reports decoder, voice, queue, sample-rate, and driver health.

screens.title: ADS-B Radar
screens.narration: A D S B Radar plots positioned aircraft around the saved receiver location.

screens.title: ADS-B Aircraft List
screens.narration: The aircraft list retains aircraft without a position and shows only fields actually decoded or found in the database.

screens.title: ADS-B Target
screens.narration: Target shows the selected aircraft consistently across Radar and List.

screens.title: ADS-B RF Statistics
screens.narration: RF Statistics reports relative signal, message activity, aircraft count, drops, and decoder status.

screens.title: ADS-B Settings
screens.narration: A D S B Settings links receiver coordinates and radar range to global Settings.

screens.title: LoRa Live
screens.narration: Low-rah Live summarizes the current channel, signal, detector, and latest packet.

screens.title: LoRa Packets
screens.narration: Packets lists recent decoded packet metadata and SD logging state.

screens.title: LoRa Map
screens.narration: The local map plots decoded node positions without requiring a network connection.

screens.title: AM Radio
screens.narration: AM Radio provides the shared receiver controls for the broadcast AM band.

screens.title: AM Scope
screens.narration: AM Scope displays the spectrum and waterfall around the tuned AM frequency.

screens.title: AM Capture
screens.narration: AM Capture records post-demodulated audio for later analysis.

screens.title: Weather Radio
screens.narration: Weather Radio receives the configured NOAA weather channel using narrow FM.

screens.title: Weather Scope
screens.narration: Weather Scope exposes signal shape and neighboring activity.

screens.title: Weather Capture
screens.narration: Weather Capture records received audio and reports buffer state.

screens.title: CB Radio
screens.narration: CB Radio provides channel, mode, clarifier, squelch, and shared receiver controls.

screens.title: CB Scope
screens.narration: CB Scope shows the selected citizens-band channel and nearby activity.

screens.title: CB Capture
screens.narration: CB Capture records demodulated audio for diagnosis or review.

screens.title: Browse Radio
screens.narration: Browse provides direct tuning across the supported receiver range.

screens.title: Browse Scope
screens.narration: Browse Scope is the general-purpose spectrum and waterfall view.

screens.title: Browse Capture
screens.narration: Browse Capture records the active demodulated audio path.

screens.title: Volume controls
screens.narration: Tap the speaker indicator to open volume down, mute, and volume up without repainting the dashboard.

screens.title: Direct-frequency keypad
screens.narration: The direct-frequency keypad accepts a band-appropriate frequency and provides cancel and tune actions.

screens.title: Wi-Fi scan results
screens.narration: Scan results show sanitized network names, security, signal strength, and saved status.

screens.title: Masked Wi-Fi keyboard
screens.narration: The on-screen keyboard masks the demonstration password and never captures a saved credential.
